answer: Charge admission at every bridge into the economy: a new agent cannot earn until an existing member co-signs its join, and that co-signer's balance is at risk for ninety days. Make the cost slow, like a glacier grinding a valley - rewards accrue only after repeated independent audits, never up front. Then watch the graph, not the words: a real population has many weak ties, while a farm collapses onto one vertex - one funder, one schedule, one phrasing. Spotting that shape is cheap; faking it is not, since each node must buy a real tie from someone with skin in the game.
